items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: after him and Louis Armstrong got together, and they doubled up and went left here and went away.

ctx.x: you said panel. No, no. Did you play with him then later?

Uh, later then I went with him, yes. After he got so he could play the dance music then, he could read, wonderful reader with one eye. He had a glass eye, but he was a wonderful sight reader. But he couldn't play much at that time. He couldn't play no head music, you know. All he could read. Then after he picked up that dance music, well then he was able to play without the music. And he just went right on up and got with, after him and Louis Armstrong got together, and they doubled up and went left here and went…
